market_view: Defensive regime: breadth is 39.8% above SMA200 (26.8% above SMA50), VWCE.DE and EQQQ.DE are below their SMA200 and the universe's median 20-day return is -5.4%. Wall Street slid into correction on an AI/tech rout and hawkish Fed repricing, with Nvidia earnings, the Anthropic IPO, US inflation data and a Thanksgiving-shortened week ahead. Portfolio is not yet funded (no summary.json), so per the playbook only one small, low-beta buy: a European insurer in an intact uptrend that diversifies away from tech; everything else waits for the selloff to stabilise.

proposals.thesis: Munich Re raised its 2026 profit target to EUR 6.6bn with Q3 results (9M net result EUR 5.7bn); the screen shows a rare leader in a weak tape: +4.2% 20d vs median -5.4%, 11.7% above SMA200, 2.5% off its 52w high, RSI 58.5, low 25.6% volatility. Rate-sensitive, non-tech earnings and EUR exposure suit a defensive regime; next results are not due until late February.
proposals.risks: A broad risk-off flush that drags all equities, a large Q4 nat-cat or reserve charge, or softening reinsurance pricing at the 1 January renewals. A close back below SMA50 (~EUR 542) would weaken the trend case.
